named_subject: a sailboat (triangular sail on a mast above a long hull)
second_guess: a rowboat or fishing boat with a flag
action: The sailboat sits on the water and grows slightly larger across the frames while small grey sailboats stay on the horizon at left; between frames 4 and 5 the boat suddenly becomes larger and shifts left, then holds that size through frame 8.
identity_gap: The sail, doubled mast stroke, and open-ended hull outline match the doodle closely. In frames 2 to 4 the right (stern) end of the hull runs off the frame edge and is cut open, so the closed hull shape of the doodle is lost there.
notes: The film shows the boat growing steadily and drifting right until the sail fills the frame, while the animation stays mostly fixed and then jumps in size at frame 5. The change that would help most is to spread the scale-up evenly over all eight frames and keep the whole hull inside the frame in frames 2 to 4.
